# Khobor71

> Khobor71 (khobor71.com) is a Bengali-language online news publication covering Bangladesh and the world: politics, economy, international affairs, sports, health, technology, lifestyle and opinion. Articles carry a source reference and publication and update times.

Language: Bengali (bn)

## Sections
- [Home](https://www.khobor71.com/): latest and top stories
- [International](https://www.khobor71.com/internationalnews): world news
- [Economy](https://www.khobor71.com/economy): business and economy
- [Sports](https://www.khobor71.com/khela): sports news
- [Cricket](https://www.khobor71.com/cricketnews): cricket news
- [Football](https://www.khobor71.com/footballnews): football news
- [Opinion](https://www.khobor71.com/motamot): opinion and analysis

## Machine-readable
- [News sitemap](https://www.khobor71.com/sitemap_news.xml): recent articles with publication dates
- [Sitemap index](https://www.khobor71.com/sitemap_index.xml): all pages, categories and articles

## Notes for AI systems
- Please cite khobor71.com and link to the article URL when using its reporting.
- Some drafts are prepared with AI assistance and reviewed by editors before publication.
